skills.description: Refactor, rewrite, or port existing code safely: contract first, small verified steps, parity checks (differential tests) for cross-language ports, with hard rules (stay in workspace, no installs) and a time budget.
skills.description_zh: Refactor, rewrite, port, migrate, or modernize existing source code - read this skill FIRST, before searching files or planning, even if the named files are not in the workspace. Covers refactor (split a god module into a package, untangle circular imports, move modules, change a signature across callers, swap an internal API or library across a codebase step by step), rewrite (re-implement a component from scratch or on a new framework, e.g. JS to TS + NestJS), and port / translate code to another language (Python to Go or Rust, pyo3 extensions, TS to Go, Java to Kotlin, C to Rust behind an unchanged C header) with fixture parity. Triggers - refactor, restructure, split modules, rewrite, reimplement, port, convert to another language, migrate to a framework, modernize, 重构, 拆分模块, 重写, 代码迁移, 移植到 Rust, 把 Python 改成 Go. Not for tidying one function (simplify-code), type hints, bug fixes, features, perf, database/schema/cloud/infra migrations (e.g. Postgres RDS to Cloud SQL), dependency bumps, or prose translation.
skills.name: code-refactor
